notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth v1.0.1.4 released!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We are releasing a patch for [b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b], bringing the game to version 1.0.1.4. You can find the changelog down below. Enjoy!


[b]Changelog[/b]

• Fix for game hang in combat caused by moving Outrider units in combat
• Fix for multiple issues caused by engaging a multi-army structure, winning a combat, then cancelling further engagements
• Fix for game hang in combat where the unit being targeted was not considered part of the opposing army
• Fix for issue meaning you could occasionally not load autosaves
• Fix for 'ghost armies' persisting on the strategic map

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth is out of Early Access!
notes.notes:
[i]Many generations ago, the sun began slowly dying, and in turn society too began to weaken. Over countless millennia, resources have dwindled, civilizations have collapsed, and population numbers have fallen.
[/i]
During [b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b]'s time in Early Access, you have learned how to customize armies and forge grand strategies by choosing between dozens of heroes and units. You've mastered special abilities, such as sneaking up on the opponent's hero to assassinate them, or dominating the skies to strike at the heart of the enemy forces from the air.

Thanks to the support and feedback of the players, today [b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b] has concluded the final stage of its Early Access period. With the new patch and the recent addition of the single player campaign, the game is now complete, though developers Auroch Digital will continue working closely with the community to ensure [b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b] is the best strategy experience possible.

The recently added campaign is set in a far future, where The Skywatchers are one of the last remaining tribes of humanity and you will witness their challenging journey. This long travel through glacial wastelands is called the Northwalk, where The Skywatchers desperately struggle to find a new home that can sustain life. But the cold is not the worst enemy out there, something else is lurking...

There are whispers of strange machines out in the wilds. Their plans are unknown. They are the Automata.

The Story update was the last of the major updates following the initial Early Access launch. With this new content, you meet key Heroes such as Seibal, a soldier who have survived for many years alone, and Chanal Goodgrass, a fighter who gambles with her own life readily for the benefit of the greater good.

If you want to know everything about the game and build a specific play-style to prevail against your opponents in the online multiplayer or single player Skirmish mode, check the official site [url=http://oldearth.slitherine.com/]here![/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450/

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth Story Update
notes.notes:
[b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b] gets its last major update and draws closer to full release! 

Play through a lengthy single player campaign, immerse yourself in the story, and explore the fascinating lore behind the setting. Follow the nomadic Skywatchers clan in its struggle for survival in the frozen wastelands of what remains of Earth. 

Lead them on the Northwalk, through various perils and deadly ambushes by marauders and slavers, as they migrate north trying to reach a promised land of warmth. Learn about the stories of key heroes, such as the fiery Chanal Goodgrass and mysterious Seibal. And prepare to witness the hardest challenge the Skywatchers have ever faced: there are odd whispers of dangerous machines hiding in the wilderness and salvation lies beyond untold hazards, their path fraught with danger.

[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Last%20Days%20of%20Old%20Earth/story2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth Air Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b] receives a new [b]major update[/b], the [b]Air Update[/b]! Death now comes from above as players have the opportunity to dominate the skies of the frozen planet. 

Decks can now be upgraded with[b] new Aircraft Units [/b]with specific abilities such as Airstrike, Air Recon and Anti-Air adding a completely new layer of strategy to the game. Strike at the heart of your opponent's forces from the air, softening up their armies or send out aircraft to scout and investigate unexplored areas of the map, quickly revealing the enemy's plans.

Structures themselves can host [b]new specific facilities[/b] for keeping enemy air units at bay. Skywatchers can count on Anti-Air ability for fortify their defences and shoot down hostiles. On the other side Automata has the Pulse Shielding technology that sum the Defence of Automata Units within the structure it resides, both during Airstrikes and normal combat.

The game is currently in Early Access on Steam and the Air update is the third of [b]four planned major updates[/b] following the game's initial launch, so stay tuned for more news, and don’t forget to visit the official site [url=oldearth.slitherine.com/]here[/url].

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450/


[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Last%20Days%20of%20Old%20Earth/aircraft_skywatchers.jpg[/img][img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Last%20Days%20of%20Old%20Earth/anti_air_facilities.jpg[/img]


[b]Changelog:[/b]

Air Recon - send out your aircraft to scout ahead of your position and investigate unexplored areas of the map, quickly revealing your opponent's plans.
Airstrike - Strike at the heart of your opponent's forces from the air, softening up their armies and minimising the risk to your own Units.
Anti-Air - With the war now raging in the skies, you'll need this ability to fortify your defences and keep enemy aircraft at bay.

Four new Aircraft Units and two new Facilities;
[b]
Skywatchers[/b]

Huracan Aircrawler – Multi-purpose aircraft, equally useful for long range reconnaissance and Airstrikes.
Oryon Airship – Though its range is short, this bomber hits hard against enemy combatants.
Gunnery Platform – allows Skywatcher Infantry Units within the structure containing it the ability to perform Anti-Air against any aircraft foolish enough to get close to it.
[b]
Automata[/b]

Azor – Long range but light aircraft, perfect for spying on the activities of your opponent.
Neptuno – This attack craft is durable, impactful, and extremely deadly.
Pulse Shielding – adds to the Defence of Automata Units within the structure it resides, both during Airstrikes and normal combat.

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth Stealth Update!
notes.notes:
[b]Last Days of Old Earth[/b] receives its second [b]major Content Update [/b]with the addition of [b]Stealth[/b] and [b]Facilities Mechanics[/b]!

Players can now upgrade their decks with new[b] Heroes, Units,[/b] and [b]Facilities[/b], with specific abilities such as [b]Assassination, Sabotage[/b] and [b]Detection[/b] adding a completely new layer of strategy to the game. Sneak up on your opponent’s hero to assassinate them or destroy building facilities to thwart your enemy’s best laid plans.
However, Skywatchers and Automata need to be cautious: with a balanced deck, both have the skill to [b]detect hidden Heroes and Units[/b] and neutralize them before they have the chance to put their devious plans into action.

Structures themselves can be strengthened by [b]new facilities[/b], such as Sentient Network that improves the Garrison’s detection ability or the Ouroboros Recycler that refunds material from the cost of playing a card.

[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Last%20Days%20of%20Old%20Earth/LDoOE-Screenshot/Stealth_assassination.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Last%20Days%20of%20Old%20Earth/LDoOE-Screenshot/skywatchers_facilities.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Last%20Days%20of%20Old%20Earth/LDoOE-Screenshot/skywatchers_new_units.jpg[/img]

The game is currently in Early Access on Steam and the [b]Stealth update[/b] is the second of [url=http://oldearth.slitherine.com/assets/Uploads/the-game.jpg]four planned major updates[/url] following the game's initial launch.

Last Days of Old Earth is constantly being improved, so stay tuned for more news on the game’s [url=http://oldearth.slitherine.com/]official site[/url]! The war for the ice planet has never been fiercer!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450/

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth Deck Building Update!
notes.notes:
The struggle for survival on the freezing planet is about to get fierce![b] Last Days of Old Earth[/b] receives its first [b]major update[/b] with the addition of the Deck Building feature!

Now you will have the chance to build your own decks and customize your armies around your favourite heroes and units, to fight both against the AI and other human players.

This incredibly flexible system allows you to create and store your own decks. You can also[b] import[/b] decks from the newly made Last Days of Old Earth’s [url=http://oldearth.slitherine.com]official site[/url]!

[img]http://www.matrixgames.com/amazon/Screenshots/Polaris/Deck%20building.jpg[/img]

The game is currently in early access and the Deck Building update is just the first of four major updates following the launch.

[img]http://oldearth.slitherine.com/assets/Uploads/the-game.jpg[/img]

This major update comes with many bugfixes and tweaks, further polishing your gaming experience.

Last but not least, the new [url=http://oldearth.slitherine.com]official site[/url] is now [b]live[/b]! Master the game by learning everything there is to know by visiting it, and use it to exchange Decks with your friends!

[b]Full Change Log[/b]:
•	Deckbuilder added
•	Custom deck selection for Skirmish & Multiplayer game modes
•	New 'Sudden Death' game mode, triggering a new Victory Condition based on territory under Supply
•	Two new cards! Clanship for Skywatchers and VN Walker for Automata!
•	Option to Tab through units that have not exhausted their movement
•	Fixes for various Card UI issues
•	Sprite changes for abilities
•	Fixes for issues around hero-only army engagement
•	Hang on engage overlay after engaging AI owned hero-only army (single player)
•	Various changes for Multiplayer Lobby UI
•	Movement AP cost display on tile displayed now removed after paying cost
•	No longer possible to start an empty skirmish by cancelling custom deck select for the first opponent

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth is released in Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
The countdown is over: our planet is freezing to death. Humans and Automata [b]are now competing to rule over the frozen wasteland of a formerly flourishing world! [/b]

Today you have the chance to[b] fight for survival as Last Days of Old Earth is entering Steam Early Access![/b]

Set in an icy, post-apocalyptic world,[b] Last Days of Old Earth mixes elements of strategy and card-driven games[/b] in a unique way. At this stage[b] the game offers both a single player Skirmish mode and online multiplayer.[/b]

And, to help newcomers to jump into the game in no time, [b]in-game tutorials[/b] have been created alongside[b]a  growing official wiki of the game[/b], powered by [url=http://lastdaysofoldearth.gamepedia.com/Last_Days_of_Old_Earth_Wiki]Gamepedia![/url]

But the launch on Early Access is only the beginning of the journey for[b] Last Days of Old Earth[/b]. Developer Auroch Digital has[b] already planned a set of major updates [/b]that will bring even more variety into the game!

And if you are eager to see some action, don’t miss our Twitch Stream tonight (March 3, 20.00 CEST)! We are going to show players the current version of the game on our official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch channel![/url]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450/

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth Officially goes on Early Access on March, 3!
notes.notes:
Today we can officially announce that [b]Last Days of Old Earth enters Steam Early Access on March 3![/b]

This immersive and deep game is a unique mix of tactical strategy and card elements from developer Auroch Digital, and launches with single-player skirmish mode, a tutorial to get you up-to-speed on the basics, and a competitive multiplayer system.

https://youtu.be/-PVSt5EF85M

Early Access players will have the chance to test both factions and dozens of heroes and units on randomly generated maps, in both single and multiplayer. Major content updates bringing new game mechanics and modes are already planned, and the developers are keen to respond to feedback from the community to fine-tune every aspect of Last Days of Old Earth.

In addition, on February 11, at 20:00 CET / 19:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EST we are giving players a sneak peak of the game on the official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch channel[/url] of the Slitherine Group!

Players eager to have an even earlier taste of what's in store can watch our new video introducing the key elements to keep in mind while building and developing a faction.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450/.

notes.title: Last Days of Old Earth opens for Beta applications!
notes.notes:
[url=http://slitherine.com/beta_test][img]http://www.slitherine.com/img/Steam_Special_Announcement_Final.jpg[/img][/url]

Your days are numbered... are you ready to survive against all odds?

In[b] Last Days of Old Earth[/b] you're challenged to lead two powerful factions across the bitterly cold husk that is our planet, struggling against a harsh landscape devastated by the radical climate change brought about by a dying sun.

The game launches on Steam Early Access in February 2016, and will be fully playable on this date! Before that though, we're asking you to help us to make a great game even better, as part of our exclusive beta.

By applying for the beta [url=http://slitherine.com/beta_test]here[/url] you'll have the chance to contribute to, and be a part of, the direction of this exciting new title.

[b]Please note[/b]: though the Early Access will be available through Steam, for the Beta you need to subscribe directly from the [url=http://slitherine.com/beta_test]dedicated beta  area[/url] on the Slitherine Site.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/376450
